_comment: Canonical list of components that MDX pages may use without importing them.
scripts/gen-mdx-components.mjs reads this to build mdx-components.tsx.
It is a file rather than a scan of the content because the scan's own input
is what scripts/migrate-imports.mjs deletes: running the generator after the
codemod found zero components and silently emptied the map. The codemod now
unions what it strips into this list, so the order of the two no longer
Phase 6 added the twelve remaining .astro components, so every component the content uses is now React.
`aliases` maps the JSX tag a page uses to the component that provides it, for content that imported under a different local name.
`starlightPrimitives` are re-implementations of @astrojs/starlight/components, imported from one shared file.
`asides` are emitted by the remark admonition transform and live together in Aside.tsx.
